email_subject: Application - Digital Content and Web Publishing Coordinator
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Content and Web Publishing Coordinator role for your client in Brussels. With hands-on experience in web publishing, CMS management and editorial work, I am confident I can support the Global Gateway showcasing digital experience from day one.

In my current roles, I manage content in WordPress and Shopify, review and adapt texts to editorial standards, and ensure multimedia assets are correctly categorised and published. I have coordinated with multiple stakeholders, including clients and team members, to collect and follow up on content submissions. My technical background in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, combined with daily use of AI tools, allows me to perform quality checks, test digital products and identify improvements efficiently.

I am organised, detail-oriented and comfortable working autonomously in complex environments. I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to this project.

Kind regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Digital Content and Web Publishing Coordinator position for your client in Brussels. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and web publishing, I have developed the skills to coordinate content, manage CMS platforms and ensure high-quality digital experiences.

In my freelance work and at Episto, I have been responsible for publishing and updating content on WordPress and Shopify, reviewing texts and multimedia assets for quality and relevance, and ensuring correct categorisation. I have liaised with clients and colleagues to collect content, follow up on submissions and maintain consistency across websites. My experience with copyright and licensing comes from managing images and videos for client sites, where I verify usage rights and attribution. I am also proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and use AI tools daily to streamline content workflows.

My technical skills in HTML, CSS and JavaScript enable me to perform functional and usability testing, check navigation and rendering, and report issues effectively. I am organised, detail-oriented and thrive in collaborative environments, having worked with diverse stakeholders on projects such as building a pharmacists' association site with ~600 member profiles.

I am eager to bring my editorial eye, technical understanding and proactive approach to the Global Gateway project. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Managed CMS content for client websites in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) and Shopify, including publishing, updating and categorising pages, blog posts and media.
- Reviewed and adapted texts and multimedia assets for editorial quality, thematic fit and technical suitability, ensuring compliance with copyright and licensing requirements.
- Coordinated with clients and team members to request, collect and follow up on content submissions, maintaining consistency across multiple websites.
- Performed quality control and usability testing on websites, checking navigation, display, links and content rendering, and reporting issues for timely correction.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office (strong Excel), with daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for content workflows, and technical skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript for digital product testing.
